# How to animate a Blender or three.js previz with Seedance 2.5

**An approved previz, cast and locked track become per-shot model picks, a cheap 480p pass, three takes per cut and plates.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_2ea643e37327.webp" alt="A grey-box previz shot and its cheap 480p Seedance pass play side by side: a starfighter faces a giant toothed tile monster in space." width="480"></p>

Animate a video once the previz, characters, moodboard, script and sound exist. Decide per element whether code, AI video or both makes it, pick Seedance 2.5 or another model per shot, run a cheap 480p pass before paying for quality, choose one long generation or short clips, roll takes that differ only in performance, cut picture to the locked track, and generate plates the next agent can add motion design to and edit. Built from working AI filmmakers, vendor guides, sync standards and the film and animation canon, with frame counts, prompts, a take checker and a database directory. Use for "animate my previz", "Blender to Seedance", "three.js to video", "grey box to video", "which model for this shot", "Seedance or Kling", "long take or short clips", "480p draft", "animate to the beat", "cartoon timing", "music video from my previz", "footage ready for motion design". Not for building the previz (threejs-animatic, varg-previz), making the sound (video-sound) or the final edit (varg-video-editing).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-animate                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills video-animate --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Animate my approved three.js previz in ./previz to the locked track, 9:16, with a cheap 480p pass first"
- "Which model for each shot in shots.md: Seedance 2.5, Kling 4 or code? Price the runs before spending"
- "Turn this Blender grey-box render into a 20-second Seedance clip and give me three performance takes"
